sinopsis.es: Rosa, compositora de música contemporánea, da su primera entrevista televisiva en la casa de su colega Tere para ocultárselo a su marido. La charla se ve interrumpida por cortes de luz y un perro que no para de ladrar.
sinopsis.en: Rosa, a contemporary music composer, gives her first television interview at her colleague Tere's house to hide it from her husband. The conversation is interrupted by power outages and a dog that won't stop barking.
